title: Strict integral pullback comparison data
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and a scheme X, use the continuous internal integral coefficient and its finite quotients of [sk-def-pe-derived-completion]. Define the strict quotient tower of a complex by the tensor reductions at exponents n+1 and their quotient transitions; its quotient maps form a strict augmentation. For g:X→Y apply exact inverse image levelwise and take the zero-homotopy map to its shifted Roos cocone. Separately restrict the integral coefficient to constant integral scalars, form its constant quotient tower and augmentation, and use the unique inverse-image/restriction comparison normalized on scalar-extension generators. These are exactly the existing definitions formerly in IntegralTensorPullback; all bodies and names are unchanged.
